content.text: In Zimbabwe, where I'm writing from, the local bank collapsed last year, making it impossible to accept traditional online payments from Stripe, a system most digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-actually|How Creators]] rely on. This is a classic case of infrastructure confinement – when a country's or a platform's restrictions limit your ability to create, sell, and own your digital products freely. Today, we'll explore how to sell music online and accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-explained-digital-creators-stripe-2|bitcoin]] without relying on Stripe or any other restricted platform. By the end of this breakdown, you'll understand the infrastructure required to deploy a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-2|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] digital commerce stack that's not dependent on any intermediaries, allowing you to retain up to 98% of your earnings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

At its core, this infrastructure is about deploying a stack of free and paid tools that give you full control over your digital products and their delivery. The key components include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This setup allows you to sell digital products like music, ebooks, courses, and more without relying on Stripe or any other restricted platform.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Let's dive deeper into the architecture. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your digital products, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic, making it possible to automate delivery and other tasks. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments verifies on-chain crypto payments, ensuring that your earnings are secure and reliable. In this infrastructure, you're not renting a platform's services – you're owning and controlling every aspect of the process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
This infrastructure retains up to 98% of your earnings, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, start by selecting the tools you need, such as the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for instant download. Then, set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Finally, set up your payment system with NOWPayments and start selling your digital products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question – how do I sell music online without Stripe? The answer is simple: deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using free and paid tools that give you full control over your digital products and their delivery. With this infrastructure, you can automate delivery, store orders, and verify on-chain crypto payments, all without relying on Stripe or any other restricted platform.
NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee for on-chain crypto payments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Purchase the Complete Builder Kit for instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Set up your payment system with NOWPayments. Test your setup to ensure a smooth transaction process.
